Asana offers a `free tier as well as several paid subscription plans` on the [Asana Pricing Page](https://google.com/goto?url=CAESVgHEIkXXiLNJzhYZmvtXRX6B8Jt1G4SDckH70KRsMYgizQjrMdrDOofnHbrSz3l9F7UX5bMUKXFb0tcgYtlqSIO5EkyJNLniFBa55spiAOaiK9VxB6X0):[[1]](https://google.com/goto?url=CAESVgHEIkXXiLNJzhYZmvtXRX6B8Jt1G4SDckH70KRsMYgizQjrMdrDOofnHbrSz3l9F7UX5bMUKXFb0tcgYtlqSIO5EkyJNLniFBa55spiAOaiK9VxB6X0)[[2]](https://google.com/goto?url=CAESZQHEIkXXON9BDtzBmiQF-XfLPlp59ghpsdU2OU4nu_ZNjFp7mt1Y_kqou_rzd_u40WUtQ0TYsx9EBZX_dvR7p_DcvPFUNQbv8GWVt74560iAVsf68uAimXdVSsYHAYDDlRrxzzHG)

### Asana Plans & Pricing (per user, per month)

- **Personal** (Free forever):
	- **Cost:** $0 (supports up to 2 users)
	- **Features:** Unlimited tasks and projects, list/board/calendar views, and 100MB file storage limit.[[1]](https://google.com/goto?url=CAESVgHEIkXXiLNJzhYZmvtXRX6B8Jt1G4SDckH70KRsMYgizQjrMdrDOofnHbrSz3l9F7UX5bMUKXFb0tcgYtlqSIO5EkyJNLniFBa55spiAOaiK9VxB6X0)[[2]](https://google.com/goto?url=CAESYwHEIkXXtByt1xeyPnJWnMe_EnyUR5ZsgMTCAIpDDPnmJ-3deSIiXk_uf0FO4X_EIhsFwYFW0GtXpl6Zn0WBg2O0ECQAVlQpvqRZ7c0YGOKLGYuoTEjDyIgsrPbDedy0dSAu6g)[[3]](https://google.com/goto?url=CAEScQHEIkXXAn4DeBACElHrHf_l_64iLvFPTB5LSCdVVdMBgGou6qvmnfHq-cSLh6_k3IVSTi8eDH5DUK0pOGdDdkFPeVm8IIhxUtO8plE4HfKMG8CqrWfXfMLc-IsTnaI4kGs2-D0AZMTiaBY3_2oH5Npq)
- **Starter**:
	- **Cost:** **$10.99 per user/month** (billed annually) or **$13.49 per user/month** (billed monthly).
	- **Features:** Timeline and Gantt views, custom fields, unlimited automations, and AI Studio basic credits.[[1]](https://google.com/goto?url=CAEScQHEIkXXAn4DeBACElHrHf_l_64iLvFPTB5LSCdVVdMBgGou6qvmnfHq-cSLh6_k3IVSTi8eDH5DUK0pOGdDdkFPeVm8IIhxUtO8plE4HfKMG8CqrWfXfMLc-IsTnaI4kGs2-D0AZMTiaBY3_2oH5Npq)[[2]](https://google.com/goto?url=CAESZAHEIkXXcms0ctLo-d5PS3GuTJJzjxM6tF2PMrUVxOBAQzWHi3YuLAxMaD161AHsur9LjntYe2r-lYKmS1mfCd3Ogpp0H6DbRtZQLDjIDjg3idEd7MqikNL1e7Ovc4sI8vjaOK0)[[3]](https://google.com/goto?url=CAESVgHEIkXXiLNJzhYZmvtXRX6B8Jt1G4SDckH70KRsMYgizQjrMdrDOofnHbrSz3l9F7UX5bMUKXFb0tcgYtlqSIO5EkyJNLniFBa55spiAOaiK9VxB6X0)[[4]](https://google.com/goto?url=CAESZQHEIkXXON9BDtzBmiQF-XfLPlp59ghpsdU2OU4nu_ZNjFp7mt1Y_kqou_rzd_u40WUtQ0TYsx9EBZX_dvR7p_DcvPFUNQbv8GWVt74560iAVsf68uAimXdVSsYHAYDDlRrxzzHG)[[5]](https://google.com/goto?url=CAESbQHEIkXXEW00P29-KZJJcowAT0ZyRreO-CFueD9rT6S3mUGGDKZLDZD2NDhplfs6WLYSLqa1C3cX-a-48wvZCegfbgX3YHl0uGiIwrMXSjowdx6SvJRnd1OaVSGXy7wWlYLESEamP4BqgfG0K8k)
- **Advanced**:
	- **Cost:** **$24.99 per user/month** (billed annually) or **$30.49 per user/month** (billed monthly).
	- **Features:** Portfolios, goals, resource management, AI meetings, and expanded AI Studio credits.[[1]](https://google.com/goto?url=CAESVgHEIkXXiLNJzhYZmvtXRX6B8Jt1G4SDckH70KRsMYgizQjrMdrDOofnHbrSz3l9F7UX5bMUKXFb0tcgYtlqSIO5EkyJNLniFBa55spiAOaiK9VxB6X0)[[2]](https://google.com/goto?url=CAESZAHEIkXXcms0ctLo-d5PS3GuTJJzjxM6tF2PMrUVxOBAQzWHi3YuLAxMaD161AHsur9LjntYe2r-lYKmS1mfCd3Ogpp0H6DbRtZQLDjIDjg3idEd7MqikNL1e7Ovc4sI8vjaOK0)[[3]](https://google.com/goto?url=CAESZQHEIkXXON9BDtzBmiQF-XfLPlp59ghpsdU2OU4nu_ZNjFp7mt1Y_kqou_rzd_u40WUtQ0TYsx9EBZX_dvR7p_DcvPFUNQbv8GWVt74560iAVsf68uAimXdVSsYHAYDDlRrxzzHG)[[4]](https://google.com/goto?url=CAESbQHEIkXXEW00P29-KZJJcowAT0ZyRreO-CFueD9rT6S3mUGGDKZLDZD2NDhplfs6WLYSLqa1C3cX-a-48wvZCegfbgX3YHl0uGiIwrMXSjowdx6SvJRnd1OaVSGXy7wWlYLESEamP4BqgfG0K8k)
- **Enterprise & Enterprise Plus**:
	- **Cost:** Custom pricing (contact sales).
	- **Features:** SAML, SCIM, advanced admin controls, HIPAA compliance, and data residency options.[[1]](https://google.com/goto?url=CAESVgHEIkXXiLNJzhYZmvtXRX6B8Jt1G4SDckH70KRsMYgizQjrMdrDOofnHbrSz3l9F7UX5bMUKXFb0tcgYtlqSIO5EkyJNLniFBa55spiAOaiK9VxB6X0)[[2]](https://google.com/goto?url=CAESZAHEIkXXcms0ctLo-d5PS3GuTJJzjxM6tF2PMrUVxOBAQzWHi3YuLAxMaD161AHsur9LjntYe2r-lYKmS1mfCd3Ogpp0H6DbRtZQLDjIDjg3idEd7MqikNL1e7Ovc4sI8vjaOK0)[[3]](https://google.com/goto?url=CAESbQHEIkXXEW00P29-KZJJcowAT0ZyRreO-CFueD9rT6S3mUGGDKZLDZD2NDhplfs6WLYSLqa1C3cX-a-48wvZCegfbgX3YHl0uGiIwrMXSjowdx6SvJRnd1OaVSGXy7wWlYLESEamP4BqgfG0K8k)

### Common Add-Ons

- **Timesheets and Budgets:** $5.99 per user/month (billed annually)
- **AI Credits / Studio Add-ons:** Prepaid and pay-as-you-go credit options available beyond the basic included caps.[[1]](https://google.com/goto?url=CAESVgHEIkXXiLNJzhYZmvtXRX6B8Jt1G4SDckH70KRsMYgizQjrMdrDOofnHbrSz3l9F7UX5bMUKXFb0tcgYtlqSIO5EkyJNLniFBa55spiAOaiK9VxB6X0)[[2]](https://google.com/goto?url=CAESZQHEIkXXON9BDtzBmiQF-XfLPlp59ghpsdU2OU4nu_ZNjFp7mt1Y_kqou_rzd_u40WUtQ0TYsx9EBZX_dvR7p_DcvPFUNQbv8GWVt74560iAVsf68uAimXdVSsYHAYDDlRrxzzHG)

To help you pick the right option, tell me:

- **How many people** are on your team?
- **What key features** do you need (like Gantt timelines, private goals, or time tracking)?
